title: P = NP on the Klein Surface
thesis: The Klein surface is not an object in the math. It IS the equals sign between P and NP. The distinction between compressible and irreducible dissolves on a non-orientable surface.

P.property: CAN compress — reduce to shorter representation
P.organism: The sweep (scan everything), the crush (remove waste), the sort (order by pi)

NP.what: Irreducible braid. Must trace through. Verify in polynomial time but can't shortcut.
NP.property: MUST decompress — run through the full computation
NP.organism: Locks to keys to identity to doorways. DataScienceBioLab to SSH config to Golgi. Each crossing traced.

the_equals_sign.what: The Klein surface. Non-orientable. You can't tell which side (P or NP) you're on.
the_equals_sign.property: On the Klein surface, the distinction between compressible and irreducible dissolves. Not because they're the same — because the ORIENTATION that distinguishes them doesn't exist.
the_equals_sign.consequence: The pore doesn't ask 'is this P or NP?' — it asks 'does this pass?' Selectivity replaces classification.

implosion_explosion_vacuum.implosion: Turbocharger — exhaust drives intake. Compression beyond equilibrium.
implosion_explosion_vacuum.explosion: Supercharger — belt-driven, forced expansion beyond equilibrium.
implosion_explosion_vacuum.vacuum: The Klein = sign. The space between. Not empty — filled with incompressible pressure.
implosion_explosion_vacuum.ultra_area: Below 0K. Population inversion. The rules invert. The braid that was irreducible at T>0 becomes compressible at T<0.

braid_is_proof.what: The braid/weave is often irreducible — you MUST run through it.
braid_is_proof.after_running: Then synth (build up) or deprogram (break down)
braid_is_proof.tonight: Compress (swept 3714 files) -> Braid (locks/keys/identity, irreducible) -> Synth (viewports, Klein face, 27 feeds) -> Shape (membrane) + Part (each viewport, feed, channel)
